<!--
  The simple call to action (model cta@1): one band with an optional badge, the heading, a description and up to
  two links styled as buttons (the first primary, the second secondary; each drawn when its label and its
  address are both set). Text only (a picture beside the copy is the split or the hero). Axes: layout (stack:
  the copy and the actions in one column, placed by the align setting; between: the copy at the start, the
  actions at the end from md up), surface (muted: a muted band, outline: a bordered card).
-->
<script lang="ts">
export type CtaSimpleProps = {
  id: string;
  badge?: string;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  actionLabel?: string;
  actionHref?: string;
  secondaryActionLabel?: string;
  secondaryActionHref?: string;
  level?: 1 | 2 | 3;
  padding?: "compact" | "standard" | "spacious";
  align?: "start" | "center" | "end";
  layout?: "stack" | "between";
  surface?: "muted" | "outline";
  landmarkLabel?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from "vue";
import Badge from "../compose/Badge.vue";
import Block from "../compose/Block.vue";
import Box from "../compose/Box.vue";
import Container from "../compose/Container.vue";
import Group from "../compose/Group.vue";
import LinkButton from "../compose/LinkButton.vue";
import Stack from "../compose/Stack.vue";
import Text from "../compose/Text.vue";
import Title from "../compose/Title.vue";
import { cn, urlOf } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  badge = "",
  title,
  description = "",
  actionLabel = "",
  actionHref = "",
  secondaryActionLabel = "",
  secondaryActionHref = "",
  level = 2,
  padding = "standard",
  align = "center",
  layout = "stack",
  surface = "muted",
  landmarkLabel,
} = defineProps<CtaSimpleProps>();
const titleId = computed(() => id + "-title");
const column = computed(() =>
  (align as string) === "center" ? "center"
  : (align as string) === "end" ? "end"
  : "start"
);
const textAlign = computed(() =>
  (align as string) === "center" ? "text-center"
  : (align as string) === "end" ? "text-end"
  : "text-start"
);
const itemsAlign = computed(() =>
  (align as string) === "center" ? "items-center"
  : (align as string) === "end" ? "items-end"
  : "items-start"
);
const selfAlign = computed(() =>
  (align as string) === "center" ? "self-center"
  : (align as string) === "end" ? "self-end"
  : ""
);
const frame = computed(() =>
  (layout as string) === "between" ? "flex flex-col gap-8 md:flex-row md:items-center md:justify-between"
  : "flex flex-col gap-6"
);
const band = computed(() =>
  (surface as string) === "outline" ? "rounded border border-border bg-card p-8 text-card-foreground md:p-12"
  : "rounded bg-muted p-8 md:p-12"
);
</script>

<template>
  <Block
    tag="section"
    :class="
      (padding as string) === 'compact' ? 'py-8 lg:py-16'
      : (padding as string) === 'spacious' ? 'py-24 lg:py-40'
      : 'py-16 lg:py-32'
    "
    :aria-labelledby="(landmarkLabel ? undefined : titleId)"
    :aria-label="landmarkLabel"
    data-slot="cta-simple"
  >
    <Container class="mx-auto w-full max-w-6xl px-4">
      <Box :class="cn(band, frame)">
        <Stack gap="4" :align="column">
          <Badge v-if="badge" variant="secondary">
            {{ badge }}
          </Badge>
          <Title :as="level" size="3xl" weight="bold" :class="cn('max-w-2xl tracking-tight', textAlign)" :id="titleId">
            {{ title }}
          </Title>
          <Text v-if="description" size="lg" :class="cn('text-muted-foreground', textAlign)">
            {{ description }}
          </Text>
        </Stack>
        <Group
          v-if="((actionLabel && actionHref) || (secondaryActionLabel && secondaryActionHref))"
          gap="4"
          align="center"
          :justify="column"
          class="flex-wrap"
        >
          <LinkButton v-if="(actionLabel && actionHref)" variant="default" size="lg" :href="urlOf(actionHref)">
            {{ actionLabel }}
          </LinkButton>
          <LinkButton
            v-if="(secondaryActionLabel && secondaryActionHref)"
            variant="secondary"
            size="lg"
            :href="urlOf(secondaryActionHref)"
          >
            {{ secondaryActionLabel }}
          </LinkButton>
        </Group>
      </Box>
    </Container>
  </Block>
</template>
